message: Got it — an 8-person startup office on your 18 × 24 m plot: an open studio, a meeting room, a small kitchen and a washroom. Nothing blocking is left open, so I've sealed the brief and listed every value I filled in myself — single unit, 2.50 m ceiling, room sizes, no barrier-free tier. Tell me if any of those should change and I'll adjust.

brief.notes: I want to make an office for my small startup — we are 8 people, we need an open studio, a meeting room, a small kitchen and a washroom.

assumptions.basis: Non-residential building — treated as one unit; v1's cited ruleset is Bayern residential.
Single storey is the only shape v1 builds.
2.50 m clear height — comfortable for an open studio and above the Bayern minimum of 2.40 m, with room for floor and ceiling build-up.
Nothing in your description asked for step-free access; a single-unit office isn't pushed into a barrier-free tier by default. Say the word and I'll raise it.
Open studio for 8 desks at roughly 7–8 m² per person including circulation.
Meeting room seating the whole team of 8 around one table.
Small kitchenette with counter, fridge and standing room, as you described.
One washroom with WC and basin for a team of 8.
You described an office for your startup, so it's registered as a workplace rather than a home.
